items.label: Easy to Read
items.value: The watch with 12 and 24 hour markings helps you easily read military time; Full dial luminous; Case diameter 38mm/1.49in.

items.label: Nurse Watch with Secondhand
items.value: Japanese quartz movement analog watch, precise timekeeping. Highly visible red second hand makes taking accurate pulse readings a breeze.

items.label: 5ATM Waterproof Watch
items.value: Water-resistant up to 50m (164ft), Suitable for cold water showers and short leisure swimming, but not for diving or snorkeling!

items.label: Durability & Comfort
items.value: Silicone strap is soft and comfortable, easy to clean; featuring quick release spring bars for easy removal and replacement. Mineral glass is wear-resistant and scratch-resistant.

items.label: Purchase with Confidence
items.value: If the watch stops working under normal use or has other problems within 12 months after purchase, please feel free to contact us and we will provide you with a solution within 24 hours until you are satisfied.
